meta.source: S•Fashion design system — the single source of truth for colour, type, spacing and components.

tokens.name: sage-900
tokens.usage: Sage 900 (darkest). Deep accents, dense backgrounds. Print starting point: C39 M0 Y16 K71.

tokens.name: sage-700
tokens.usage: Sage 700. The primary action colour: main buttons, selected size, the editorial band. White text on it: 6.1:1; 5.6:1 against Background. Print: PANTONE 4208 C (coated). CMYK fallback: C43 M0 Y16 K58.

tokens.name: sage-500
tokens.usage: Sage 500 (brand accent). Highlights, tags, illustration and brand moments. Not for buttons or text: white on it is 3.1:1 and it is 2.9:1 against Background. Black text on it is fine (5.7:1). Print: PANTONE 4208 C at 45% tint (coated). CMYK fallback: C21 M0 Y10 K40.

tokens.name: sage-300
tokens.usage: Sage 300. Soft highlights, subtle tints. Print starting point: C14 M0 Y6 K23.

tokens.name: sage-100
tokens.usage: Sage 100 (lightest). Dividers, subtle backgrounds. Print starting point: C7 M0 Y4 K11.

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: Gold 500. The brand's warm splash: live dots, small badges, thin rules, the monogram line, highlights on photos and dark grounds. Not for text on light grounds (2.0:1). Black text on it is fine (8.1:1). Print starting point: C0 M11 Y36 K23.

tokens.name: gold-700
tokens.usage: Gold 700. Gold text on light grounds: text links ("Explore look"), small numbers and labels. 4.8:1 on `canvas`, 5.2:1 on `surface`. Not on `stylist-surface` (4.0:1). Print starting point: C0 M16 Y51 K51.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Black. Body copy, metadata, labels. Print starting point: C0 M0 Y0 K90.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Background. Page backgrounds, subtle green tint.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Surface. Cards, modals, elevated surfaces.

tokens.name: stylist-surface
tokens.usage: Quiet panels: subtotal panels, size tags, selected nav pill. Text on it is `ink` (13.2:1).

tokens.name: user-message
tokens.usage: The customer's chat message and the selected filter chip. Text on it is `ink` (9.3:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary. The one main button per screen, selected size, editorial band. Sage 700 in light (5.6:1 against Background), Sage 300 in dark. Text on it is `on-primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a `primary` fill: white on Sage 700 (6.1:1) in light; black on Sage 300 (9.3:1) in dark.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary. Outline and label of the secondary (outlined) button, totals and price highlights. Same green as `primary` but never as a fill, so the two buttons differ by weight, not hue. 6.1:1 on `surface` (light), 8.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent (Sage 500). Brand highlights, tags, illustration. A fill or mark only — never a button or text colour on light grounds.

tokens.name: accent-gold
tokens.usage: Gold splash for text links and small highlights. Gold 700 in light (4.8:1 on `canvas`), Gold 500 in dark (8.5:1). Use one or two gold touches per screen; never a button fill or the main action.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text primary. Headings and body text. 16:1 on `canvas`. Dark: 14.8:1 or better.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Text secondary. Captions, metadata, muted text. 5.2:1 on `canvas`, 5.6:1 on `surface`. Not for text on `stylist-surface` (4.3:1).

tokens.name: ink-label
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels in caps. 5.6:1 on `canvas`, 6.1:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Border. Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only (1.3:1).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of fields and unselected size options, so they can be found: 3.3:1 on `canvas`. Use it for inputs instead of `border-subtle`, which is too faint to find.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success. Confirmations, positive states. Text: 5.2:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning. Alerts, caution states. Use as a FILL with `black` text (6.3:1) — as text on light grounds it is only 2.8:1.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error. Errors, destructive actions. Text: 5.5:1 on `surface`; white text on it 5.5:1.

tokens.name: image-fallback
tokens.usage: Neutral block while a product image loads or fails. `ink-muted` on it: 4.8:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px gap. 5.6:1 on `canvas` (Sage 500 would be only 2.9:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen title, top of a page. One per screen. Guide range 26–30px. 72 Bold.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen title on denser screens (outfit, bag, product detail). 72 Bold.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section heads inside a screen. Guide range 20–22px. 72 Bold.

styles.name: section-sm
styles.usage: Card titles: the stylist's personal edit, order summary. 72 Bold.

styles.name: app-bar
styles.usage: Top bar title and the S.Fashion wordmark. 72 Medium.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Large, airy intro line under a headline on editorial and confirmation moments. Light is only for text 20px and up. 72 Light.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A tailored blazer, relaxed trousers and a compact black bag.
styles.usage: Default reading text, chat messages, field input. 72 Regular.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Product names, button labels, totals. 72 Bold.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, size options, nav labels, prices in lists. 72 Medium.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: Delivery and tax will be shown before a real purchase.
styles.usage: Metadata and fine print. 12px is the floor — nothing smaller. 72 Regular.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small caps label above a card title. Write it in capitals; colour `ink-label`. 72 Bold.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Refinement step: icon-to-label, price-to-name.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Base rhythm unit. Gap between chips, inside tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Product grid gap; padding inside list cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Screen side gutters at every phone width.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large break: title block to first section.

tokens.name: radius-image-sm
tokens.usage: Small product thumbnails in lists, small tiles, list rows, the icon button inside a field.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, cards. Also large product imagery.

tokens.name: radius-message
tokens.usage: Stylist and user message cards.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets and overlay menus (stylist sheet, More menu).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips, size tags, small labels, nav selection pill, and the floating bottom tab bar (round at both ends).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum interaction area for anything tappable.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: Visual chip height; the tap area still pads out to `touch-target`.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every outline and divider.

tokens.name: canvas-width
tokens.usage: Base design frame (390 × 844).

tokens.name: canvas-narrow
tokens.usage: Validate at 360 × 800.

tokens.name: canvas-wide
tokens.usage: Validate at 430 × 932.

tokens.name: tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet adaptation: 2–3 columns, wider cards.

tokens.name: desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop adaptation: stylist may sit beside the catalog.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Product columns on phone.

duration.note: Two speeds: quick for shopping interactions, slow only for editorial moments.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback: a button or card darkening as it is tapped.

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Chips, size options, toggles, save heart, focus. The default for app UI.

tokens.name: duration-standard
tokens.usage: Toast in/out, bottom sheets, content swapping in place (Swap, subtotal update).

tokens.name: duration-screen
tokens.usage: Moving between screens (push and back).

tokens.name: duration-editorial
tokens.usage: Scroll reveals on editorial content only: campaign tiles, lookbooks. Never on shopping controls.

tokens.name: duration-hero
tokens.usage: One hero entrance on an editorial or campaign page. Never in checkout, bag or product selection.

easing.note: One brand curve for things arriving; a quicker curve for things leaving.

tokens.name: ease-brand
tokens.usage: Default for everything entering or settling: soft deceleration, no bounce.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving the screen (toast out, sheet closing): they accelerate away so they don't linger.

distance.note: Motion is vertical only, and small.

tokens.name: distance-sm
tokens.usage: UI elements fading in: toast, sheet content, new list items.

tokens.name: distance-md
tokens.usage: Editorial scroll reveals: cards, text blocks.

tokens.name: distance-lg
tokens.usage: Hero titles on editorial pages. 32px is the absolute maximum.

stagger.note: Gap between items that cascade in.

tokens.name: stagger-ui
tokens.usage: Product grid and list items on first load; stop after 6 items so the list never waits.

tokens.name: stagger-editorial
tokens.usage: Editorial cards and lookbook items cascading in.
